description: Canned records behind the read-only tools, shaped like what an internal API really returns: the handful of fields an agent needs, buried in audit trails, hourly rows, and integration metadata. Nothing here calls a real system, so every run sees the same data. `today` is the scenario date the playbook gives the agent. One shipment (NS-51777) is a lookup that never finishes: it reports a little more sync progress on every retry and never returns tracking data.
